decisions.statement: The files git has are the files listed.
A file the repository ignores is not listed.
A file not yet committed is listed where the repository does not ignore that file.
A path git names more than once is listed once.
A symbolic link is the one path git has rather than the files the link reaches.
A listing git could not answer throws rather than answering empty.
A generated folder is named `generated` or `build` or `dist` or `out` or `coverage`.
A folder name is matched whole rather than as the opening of a longer name.
A name carrying `generated` before its extension was generated.
Whether a generated file is counted is answered by the caller rather than here.
A line is counted by the newline ending that line.
A last line ending in no newline is counted.
An empty file has no lines.
A file that could not be read answers no number rather than a zero.
The first column is set out to the left and every later column to the right.
A column is as wide as the widest thing that column has.
A row naming fewer columns than the widest row ends where its own columns end.
No folder is walked here.
Nothing here judges whether a file is text.
Nothing here writes.

definition: the files a checkout holds, how many lines each runs to, and the column they are set out in
